windows.60: Over the past 60 days, several visitors have expressed concerns about the food options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, noting that the menu is limited and some dishes lack flavor or proper preparation. Three critical reviews specifically mentioned issues with food quality, including bland or poorly executed items and a lack of variety. There were also comments about the value and pricing of food, with one visitor describing it as overpriced and minimal. Service and wait times were less frequently mentioned but appeared in a few reviews. Overall, while the average rating remains above four, the food offerings and menu choices are areas that need attention.
windows.90: Visitors have raised concerns about the food service, particularly regarding limited menu options, inconsistent food quality, and high prices. Several reviews mention bland or poorly prepared dishes and small portions that do not match the cost. Service issues include long wait times and periods when ordering is unavailable, causing frustration. While some healthy options are noted, overall satisfaction with the dining experience is low. Attention to menu variety, food preparation, pricing, and service efficiency would likely improve visitor experience.
